   232	 PROPOSED COMPLIANCE ORDER
   233	Pursuant to 49 United States Code § 60118, the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety
   234	Administration (PHMSA) proposes to issue to Zenith Energy Terminals Joliet Holdings, LLC’s
   235	(Zenith Energy) a Compliance Order incorporating the following remedial requirements to
   236	ensure the compliance of Zenith Energy with the pipeline safety regulations:
   237	A.
   238	
   239	In regard to Item 2 of the Notice, pertaining to the failure to maintain records for
   240	review during the inspection, Zenith Energy must formally and adequately
   241	document the integration of the 2019 ILI survey results with other available
   242	information and pipeline data elements in order to evaluate the integrity of each
   243	pipeline segment as required by the information analysis specified in § 195.452(g),
   244	and submit for Director approval within 90 days of the receipt of the Final Order.
   245	Zenith Energy must maintain documentation of such analysis and conclusions
   246	regarding the integrity of the pipeline segments as required, and incorporate this
   247	information in its reviews and plans development for safely returning to service its
   248	fully purged JBBR pipeline system that has been isolated from the Joliet terminal
   249	and placed under a nitrogen blanket since the week ending June 29, 2022, as
   250	reported to PHMSA previously.
   251	
   252	B.
   253	
   254	It is requested that Zenith Energy maintain documentation of the safety
   255	improvement costs associated with fulfilling this Compliance Order and submit the
   256	total to Gregory A. Ochs, Director, Central, Pipeline and Hazardous Materials
   257	Safety Administration. It is requested that these costs be reported in two categories:
   258	(1) total cost associated with preparation/revision of plans, procedures, studies and
   259	analyses, and (2) total cost associated with replacements, additions and other
   260	changes to pipeline infrastructure.
